1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Local Establishment in Jammu & Kashmir The bidder should preferably have an established and operational business office within the Union Territor y of Jammu & Kashmir. Documentary proof of local establishment, such as GST registration, Udyam Registr ation, Shop & Establishment Registration or other valid government registration showing the J&K business address, shall be submitted. 2. Local Service and Support Facility The bidder should have its own service centre or an authorised service partner within Jammu & Kashmir fo r providing timely maintenance, repair and warranty support for the supplied power tiller. 3. Preference to J&K-Based Sellers Preference may be extended to eligible local sellers, Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) and other eligible J&K-based suppliers in accordance with applicable Government of India and UT of J&K procurement policies and GeM provisions. 4. Local Technical Support The successful bidder shall ensure availability of a local technical representative for attending complaints, providing operational guidance and carrying out necessary repairs. Complaints shall be acknowledged with in 48 hours and attended within 7 working days. 5. Local Spare Parts Availability The bidder shall ensure the availability of essential spare parts, including rotary blades, clutch components , filters, belts, cables and other regularly required consumables through its own establishment or authorise d local service partner in J&K. 6. Proof of Local Business Registration

Bidders claiming J&K-based seller status shall upload valid documentary evidence of their registered busin ess establishment within J&K. The registration must be valid as on the last date of bid submission. 7. Delivery and Demonstration The successful bidder shall deliver the equipment at the consignee location within Jammu & Kashmir and p rovide free demonstration, installation/assembly, operational training and basic maintenance instructions. 8. Warranty and After-Sales Service Minimum 12 months comprehensive warranty against manufacturing defects from the date of successful d elivery and acceptance. The bidder shall provide warranty service at the consignee location without additi onal service or visit charges for defects covered under warranty. 9. Technical Compliance The bidder shall upload the manufacturer's technical datasheet/catalogue of the offered power tiller, clearl y indicating engine capacity, rated HP, fuel type, engine displacement, transmission system, working width , working depth and accessories supplied. 10. Local Supplier Responsibility The successful bidder shall remain responsible for ensuring uninterrupted after-sales service and warranty support within J&K, irrespective of whether the services are provided through its own establishment or an authorised local service partner. 11. Bid Evaluation The purchaser reserves the right to verify the authenticity of local business registration, service arrangem ents and submitted technical documents before award of contract. 12. Non-Compliance Any bidder furnishing false information regarding local establishment, service facilities or technical specific ations shall be liable for action as per applicable GeM terms and conditions. .
